persuasionAngle.rationale: Category managers care about one thing above all: inventory turn. They're inventory-risk-averse and need proof that premium floor space allocation drives sell-through velocity. By leading with concrete sell-through data rather than brand storytelling, we address their core objection about tight margins by proving customer pull-through justifies the investment.

creative.headline: Customers Don't Browse Patagonia
creative.statLabel: of shoppers purchase within first visit
creative.postText: While other outdoor brands see 40-50% browse rates, Patagonia drives intent-based traffic. Customers research online, arrive knowing what they want, buy and leave. The data matters more than the story. #retaildata #outdoorindustry

creative.tone: data-first confidence that directly counters their stated objection about customers browsing in-store then buying direct — flipping it into a positive about purchase intent
